note: Fixed sentences of the letter, the covering email and the message to Sitamah. Written from the old skill's rules in plain English (04/11/2026); the program fills the {fields}. Paul may change any of them here, in Claude Code.
title: Life Insurance Comparison
subject: {name} / Life Insurance Comparison – {insurers}
pattern_age_rated: Age-related: rises as you get older
guarantee_not_stated: Not stated on the document: worth confirming with {insurer}
second_life_independent: Independent cover: it stands on its own
second_life_rider: A rider on the main policy: it depends on that policy staying in force
not_on_proposal: Not on this proposal, and not confirmed for you: it comes from the insurer's general product materials. What you would need to do to use it: {conditions}
ahead_line: Ahead on the points above: {wins}. Fair trade-offs: {tradeoffs}.
ahead_none: No insurer is clearly ahead on the points above.
esc_foot_printed: The yearly percentages for {sides} are printed by the insurer.
esc_foot_calculated: The yearly percentages for {sides} are our own calculation from the printed rand figures: (this year minus last year) divided by last year.
esc_foot_na: Figures shown as 'not provided' are not in the insurer's own table.
esc_foot_outlier: {side}: the increase in year {n} ({pct}%) stands out from the surrounding years and is worth confirming with {insurer}.
esc_foot_start: The first year has no percentage because there is no earlier year to compare it with.
loyalty_closing: All of these require the policy to stay in force to keep the value.
disclaimer: The calculated projections in this document are illustrative, not guaranteed, unless the insurer's own table says otherwise. This comparison is based on the documents listed below and does not replace the policy documents.
sources_guides: General product materials used (not your own policy documents):
email_chrome: The full comparison is attached as a document. Please open it in Google Chrome, which shows it as designed.
email_cta_first: Please call or WhatsApp me if you would like to go through it together; my details are below.
email_cta_third: Please call or WhatsApp Paul Kafentzis if you would like to go through it together; the contact details are below.
email_rar: For {sides}, this comparison used the RAR and general product knowledge, not the full policy schedule.
